detective.name: the Detective
detective.silhouette: Belted trench coat with the collar up and a snap-brim fedora, a lens raised in one hand.
detective.notes: The outsider from the mainland, cleaner and sharper than the villagers: a fog trench coat belted tight, ink fedora and gloves, the magnifier's lens the accent (a lantern glint). Interact: crouches with the lens to the ground.

doctor.name: the Doctor
doctor.silhouette: Short top hat and a long frock coat, a squat bag carried low: narrow on top, heavy at one hand.
doctor.notes: Ink frock coat over a bone waistcoat and shirt, round spectacles, a short ink top hat, the black medical bag with a mustard clasp, a watch chain. Interact: kneels and opens the bag.

vicar.name: the Vicar
vicar.silhouette: Wide shovel-brimmed hat over an ankle-length cassock: a dark bell shape with a pale collar.
vicar.notes: Black cassock to the boots, white collar band and cuffs, a small prayer book at the chest (bone pages, mustard clasp). The brim must read from all 8 directions; keep the cassock one dark mass so the scarf stands out. Interact: reads from the book, head bowed.

watchman.name: the Watchman
watchman.silhouette: Tall domed helmet and a shoulder-caped greatcoat, a pole lantern held up beside him: the one look with a light above the head.
watchman.notes: Knee-length slate greatcoat with a short fog shoulder cape, a high stiff collar under the scarf, a domed watchman's helmet, a wooden rattle on the belt. The pole lantern's glass is the accent and glows in every frame; the whole figure stays inside the 1.75-tile silhouette. Interact: lifts the lantern and peers.

herbalist.name: the Herbalist
herbalist.silhouette: Deep hood up and a wide pocketed apron hung with bundles: a hunched, layered shape.
herbalist.notes: A hooded fog shawl over a bone apron with many pockets, dried herb bundles and a satchel at the hip (dried fog and bone tones, never teal), two small vial stoppers in mustard. The hood is the headgear. Interact: grinds in a mortar held at the waist.

gamekeeper.name: the Gamekeeper
gamekeeper.silhouette: A long gun slung barrel-up over one shoulder and a deerstalker: the one diagonal line above a shoulder.
gamekeeper.notes: Slate tweed shooting coat with a fog check, breeches and gaiters, a deerstalker with the flaps tied up, a game bag across the body, the fowling piece slung barrel-up (ink barrel, mustard brass). Interact: kneels and checks a snare.

lamplighter.name: the Lamplighter
lamplighter.silhouette: Bare head and a short hooded oilskin cape, a long lighting pole at a slant over the shoulder with a flame at its tip.
lamplighter.notes: Short slate oilskin cape with the hood down, bone shirt with the sleeves rolled, a brass-hooked lighting pole carried at a slant inside the 1.75-tile silhouette, its small flame the accent. Interact: raises the pole to an unseen lamp.

baker.name: the Baker
baker.silhouette: Tall pleated toque and a long white apron: the one pale figure.
baker.notes: Bone toque and apron over a fog shirt and trousers, sleeves rolled, flour on the forearms, a long wooden peel or a basket of loaves (mustard crust). The pale base is deliberate, so the Baker reads at night; keep the scarf a clear band against the apron. Interact: kneads on a board held at the waist.

fisher.name: the Fisher
fisher.silhouette: Sou'wester sloping down at the back, a knee-length smock and tall boots, a coil of net over one shoulder.
fisher.notes: Fog oilskin smock, ink sea boots to the knee, the sou'wester in mustard (the accent; keep it small), a coil of net and a cork float over the shoulder. Interact: mends a net held in both hands.

tinner.name: the Tinner
tinner.silhouette: A hard round hat with a lit candle pressed to the front, a leather jerkin and a short pick on the shoulder.
tinner.notes: Hard felt tinner's hat with a candle stuck in a clay lump at the front (its flame the accent), slate leather jerkin, fog shirt, rolled trousers with ore dust at the knees, a short pick over the shoulder. Fits Hollowmere's shut tin mine and Blackpine's working one. Interact: swings the pick low at the ground.

killer.name: the Killer
killer.silhouette: Portrait only: a long coat and a brim that keeps the face in shadow, a knife held low behind the back.
killer.notes: Never made, rendered or packed as a world character. The face stays unreadable (no eyes, a lantern rim light on the jaw); the blade's edge is the only blood. Nothing in it may echo a world look, so no portrait hints at a cover.

accomplice.name: the Accomplice
accomplice.silhouette: Portrait only: half turned away, a crowbar under the arm and a spool of red thread in the hand.
accomplice.notes: Never a world character. A forger's shape: ink-stained cuffs, a footprint stencil tucked in the coat, the thread spool in blood, the face half lit.

drifter.name: the Drifter
drifter.silhouette: Portrait only: a patched travelling coat, a bindle and a grin, a wooden knife in the belt.
drifter.notes: Never a world character. Neutral amber: mustard patches and bindle cloth, the replica knife plainly wooden. Looks like trouble on purpose.
